questions.prompt: What URL structure for individual figure share pages?
questions.description: How should the public URL for a shared figure look?
questions.recommendedAnswer: /share/fig/{shareToken} — dedicated share route, separate from document routes

questions.prompt: What should the figure share page display?
questions.description: Select all that apply to the share page.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Original figure image, PaperViz explanation/annotation, source paper title + page number, reading level used, CTA button to analyze own paper

questions.prompt: What visibility options for shared figures?
questions.description: Should figures inherit document visibility or have independent controls?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Figures inherit document visibility for now — public, unlisted, or private. No per-figure visibility override in 4.1.

questions.prompt: How should share link expiration work?
questions.description: Share links can expire based on inactivity or fixed TTL.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Reuse existing 7-day inactivity expiry for documents. Figures don't have separate expiry — document expiry kills all its figure shares.

questions.prompt: How is a share link generated?
questions.description: When does the share token get created?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Lazy generation — share token created on first share action, stored in charts table. Token is a 16-char random ID (reuse repository.NewID).

questions.prompt: Should users be able to revoke a share link?
questions.description: Can the document owner disable sharing for a figure?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — owner can toggle sharing on/off. Revoking clears the share_token. Simple and useful for privacy.

questions.prompt: The existing ShareDialog shares the document link. How should it change for figures?
questions.description: Current ShareDialog in result-page.jsx shares the full document. Should it be extended or replaced?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add per-chart share button in ChartCard. ShareDialog opens with figure-specific URL when sharing a figure, document URL when sharing full doc.

questions.prompt: What's the difference between 'unlisted' and 'private' for a document?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Unlisted = anyone with link can view (not in dashboard). Private = only owner can view (no share links work). Public = owner can view + share links work.
